summary: One review pass across all 11 model views against the approved target. Major anatomy, face, armor, and silhouette mismatches remain. The supplied deterministic report records 10 blockers and one warning; visual inspection also fails multiple criteria.

findings.message: Supplied deterministic report: both upper arms penetrate the torso by 1.45 studs, exceeding the 0.65 maximum. These measurements were not independently recomputed.
findings.recommendation: Adjust both shoulder attachments and upper-arm volumes to meet the penetration limit.

findings.message: Supplied deterministic report: all six forward claws have direction dot -0.98; both rear claws have dot -0.95. All eight fail their required direction.
findings.recommendation: Correct the orientation of each of the eight claws.

findings.message: Supplied deterministic report: height/depth ratio 1.153 is below the 1.35 review threshold.
findings.recommendation: Review body and tail proportions alongside the upright silhouette.

findings.message: The model's stacked rounded limbs, rectangular chest, short neck, and bulbous muzzle differ substantially from the target's integrated muscular anatomy, elongated armored head, and jagged dorsal shield silhouette. Dark coloration and yellow eyes provide only broad resemblance.
findings.recommendation: Rework the primary anatomical masses and silhouette against the approved target.

findings.message: The eyes appear approximately symmetric and the muzzle faces forward, but the crown is a smooth dome, the eye support reads as a flat projecting strip, and the muzzle and jaw read as stacked rounded pads. Vents cannot be verified, and the construction does not form the target's armored reptilian face.
findings.recommendation: Integrate the crown, brow, muzzle, jaw, and vents into a coherent armored head with verifiable orientations.

findings.message: Both arms crowd the torso, with their inner attachment boundaries obscured by overlapping masses and armor. Neither close-up establishes clear separation below the shoulders.
findings.recommendation: Expose a clear arm-to-torso gap below each shoulder and verify both sides.

findings.message: Left forward claws 1–3 and right forward claws 1–3 read as broad wedge caps rather than forward-pointing talons. The left and right rear claws are only partly exposed near the heels; neither can be verified as a fully exposed backward-pointing talon. The review panel and framing limit inspection of the right foot.
findings.recommendation: Orient and expose all eight pointed claws, then capture unobstructed views of both complete feet.

findings.message: The dorsal forms read as narrow, regular triangular fins or spikes rather than broad, irregular shattered storm shields. Seven distinct shield forms cannot be verified.
findings.recommendation: Create seven clearly distinguishable fractured shield forms with broad angular faces and irregular broken edges.

findings.message: The legs are bulkier than the arms, but stacked spherical segments and visibly separated toe masses undermine continuous load-bearing anatomy. A coherent massive digitigrade structure is not established.
findings.recommendation: Integrate thighs, knees, hocks, ankles, and feet into continuous digitigrade limbs.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, and defining dorsal silhouette substantially diverge from the approved target.
Forward-facing muzzle and approximate eye symmetry are visible, but coherent crown/jaw construction and vent orientation are not verified.
Both close-ups fail to establish clearance below the shoulders; the supplied deterministic report also identifies excessive penetration on both sides.
All six front claws look cap-like, neither rear claw is fully verifiable, and the supplied deterministic report flags all eight directions.
Front and side views show a vertically held torso supported by the legs, with arms off the ground. The separate height/depth warning remains.
The tail, dorsal row, and bipedal stance remain, but the target's distinctive armored head, muscular contours, and shattered shield profile are not preserved.
Visible dorsal forms resemble simple triangular spikes; seven shattered shields cannot be verified.
Leg bulk exceeds arm bulk, but segmented rounded masses and disconnected-looking feet do not establish coherent load-bearing digitigrade anatomy.
